skill_name: Describe the implications of the following quote by Tom Stoppard:
workflow: The quote by Tom Stoppard implies that we should take life one step at a time and not be too focused on our progress. We should acknowledge our past but not dwell on it, and live our lives thoughtfully. The smell of smoke serves as a reminder of our past decisions and that we should not be content with our progress and should always strive to be better than before.
